> **0.1.2** is 0.1.1 packed under L'Cronx (plugin folder `L'Cronx - VST - Loop-SaboteurXXL`); nothing else changed. Uninstall 0.1.1 first.

**Loop-SaboteurXXL**: Loop Saboteur, the glitch / chop / beat-slicer effect by Stephen McLeod Blythe / AMFAS
([clickysteve/Loop-Saboteur](https://github.com/clickysteve/Loop-Saboteur)), as a native insert effect for MPC OS on
the Akai Force. Art and build by Claude; developer L'Cronx.

Install: download `Loop-SaboteurXXL-<version>-mpc-armv7.zip`, unzip it and follow `INSTALL.md` inside (root SSH
access needed, e.g. MockbaMod; the installer stops and restarts MPC, so save your project first).

What's new: see [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/sunskiefer/Loop-SaboteurXXL/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md). Manual:
[docs/USER_GUIDE.md](https://github.com/sunskiefer/Loop-SaboteurXXL/blob/main/docs/USER_GUIDE.md).
